ee:transform.doc:name: Prepare Warning Email Payload, var : subject

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var env = upper(p("mule.env") )
var integrationType = vars.integration."integration-type" default vars.initialVariables."integration-type" default "Transaction"
var poNumber = vars.initialPayload[0].b2bMessage.header.poNumber default "N/A"
var matchPercentage = vars.validationResult.validationErrors.shipToMatchPercentage default vars.isValid.validationErrors.shipToMatchPercentage default null
--- [ env, "FCG WARNING", integrationType, "PO " ++ poNumber, if (matchPercentage != null) "Address Match " ++ ((matchPercentage as Number) as String {format: "##.##"}) ++ "%" else null ] filter ($ != null and $ != "") joinBy " | "

%dw 2.0
output application/json
var vendorName = [(p('partner.inbound.' ++ (vars.initialPayload[0].b2bMessage.header.senderId default "" as String)))] default [(p('partner.outbound.' ++ (vars.initialPayload[0].b2bMessage.header.senderId default "" as String)))] default []
var viewRecords =
(vars.emailView.value default [])
filter ((vendorName default []) contains $.trading_partner_name)
--- viewRecords."email_to_biz" contains "Y"

ee:transform.doc:name: Prepare Success Email Payload, var : subject

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain
fun safe(v, d = "N/A") = if (v == null or (v is String and trim(v) == "")) d else v
var integration = vars.integration default vars.initialVariables default {} var sysInfo = vars.systemInformation default {} var cdm = (vars.initialPayload default [])[0].b2bMessage default {} var header = cdm.header default {}
var senderKey = header.senderId default "" var vendorId = if (senderKey != "") (p("partner.inbound." ++ senderKey) default p("partner.outbound." ++ senderKey) default "N/A") else "N/A"
var poNumber = safe(header.poNumber)
var data = { flowDirection: if (lower(safe(integration.source, "APM")) == "apm") "INBOUND" else "OUTBOUND",
documentType: safe( integration."integration-type", safe(header.documentType, "API") ),
successTitle: "P21 Processing Completed",
bannerColor: "#16a34a",
status: "SUCCESS",
statusMessage: "P21 Processing Completed Successfully",
companyName: vars.purchaseOrderData.value.company_no[0] default "N/A",
vendorName: vendorId,
route: safe(integration.source, "APM") ++ " → Mule → " ++ safe(integration.target, "P21"),
businessKey: "PO " ++ poNumber,
timestamp: now() as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" },
transmissionId: safe(header.transmissionId),
keyLabel: "Correlation ID",
key: correlationId default uuid(),
transactionType: safe( integration."integration-type", safe(header.documentType, "API") ),
appName: p("api.name") default "Mule Application",
environment: upper(p("mule.env") default "DEV"),
message: "Invoice for Purchase Order " ++ poNumber ++ " has been processed successfully in P21.",
p21OrderNumber: poNumber,
statusCode: "200" }
var template = readUrl( "classpath://templates/success-template.html", "text/plain" )
--- template replace /\$\{(\w+)\}/ with ((m) -> (data[m[1]] as String) default "")

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain
var env = upper(p("mule.env") default "DEV")
var integrationType = vars.integration."integration-type" default vars.initialVariables."integration-type" default "Transaction"
var poNumber = vars.initialPayload[0].b2bMessage.header.poNumber default "N/A"
var vendorName = (p('partner.inbound.' ++ (vars.initialPayload[0].b2bMessage.header.senderId default "" as String))) default (p('partner.outbound.' ++ (vars.initialPayload[0].b2bMessage.header.senderId default "" as String))) default "N/A"
--- [ env, "FCG SUCCESS", integrationType, vendorName, "PO " ++ poNumber ] filter ($ != null and $ != "") joinBy " | "
